heart.description: Simple solid filled heart icon (Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- use for anatomical heart references instead of hand-drawing one from primitives.

brain.description: Simple flat-color brain icon, side profile (OpenMoji U+1F9E0, CC BY-SA 4.0 licensed) -- use for brain/neuroscience references instead of hand-drawing one from primitives.

stopwatch.description: Stopwatch icon (Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- use for reaction-time / timed-measurement references instead of hand-drawing a clock from primitives.

activity.description: Heartbeat/pulse-line icon (Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- use for generic bio-signal or vital-sign references (EEG, ECG, EMG) instead of hand-drawing a squiggly line.

soundwave.description: Sound-wave / oscillation icon (Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- use for signal, frequency, and rhythm references (EEG bands, tremor oscillation) instead of hand-drawing wave shapes.

grid_matrix.description: 3x3 grid icon (Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- use to represent a matrix / linear-algebra data structure instead of hand-drawing a grid from lines.

bar_chart.description: Bar chart icon (Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- use for statistics / distribution / probability references instead of hand-drawing bars or a bell curve.

graph_trend.description: Upward trend-line chart icon (Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- use for calculus/change, correlation, or rate-of-change references instead of hand-drawing an axis and line.

cpu.description: CPU chip icon (Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- use for artificial-neuron, machine-learning, or computation references instead of hand-drawing a chip.

funnel.description: Funnel icon (Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- use literally for 'many measurements funneled into mathematics' diagrams instead of hand-drawing a funnel/triangle shape.

table.description: Table icon (Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- use as a small marker for tabular/reference-card content instead of hand-drawing a grid.

hospital.description: Hospital/clinical building icon (Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- use as a stand-in for a clinical or imaging setting (e.g. MRI suite) instead of hand-drawing a building or scanner.

capsule.description: Medicine capsule icon (Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- use for drug-dose references instead of hand-drawing a pill.

clipboard_pulse.description: Clipboard-with-pulse-trace icon (Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- use for clinical measurement / vital-sign charting references (e.g. an EEG reading) instead of hand-drawing a chart on a board.

hand.description: Hand icon (Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- use as the base image for tremor/hand-motion references (animate/overlay motion separately) instead of hand-drawing a hand from primitives.

broadcast.description: Broadcast/signal-pin icon (Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- use for deep brain stimulation or BCI signal-delivery references instead of hand-drawing radiating arcs.

gear.description: Gear icon (Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- use for control-theory / engineering-intervention references instead of hand-drawing a cog.

arrow_repeat.description: Circular repeat-arrows icon (Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- use for iterative/feedback-loop references (e.g. gradient descent's repeat step) instead of hand-drawing a loop arrow.

lightbulb.description: Lightbulb icon (Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- use for 'insight' / 'pattern recognized' moments instead of hand-drawing a bulb.

bell.description: Bell icon (Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- use for alarm/alert or false-positive references instead of hand-drawing a bell.

check_circle.description: Checkmark-in-circle icon (Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- use for a correct/true-positive outcome instead of hand-drawing a checkmark.

x_circle.description: X-in-circle icon (Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- use for an incorrect/missed outcome (false negative) instead of hand-drawing an X.

rulers.description: Crossed rulers icon (Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- use for 'measurement' / 'quantification' references instead of hand-drawing a ruler.

puzzle.description: Puzzle-piece icon (Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- use for 'combining ideas together' references (e.g. applied math combining pillars) instead of hand-drawing puzzle shapes.

fig_measurement_funnel.description: Composite PNG (matplotlib layout + Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- the 'measurements funnel into mathematics' diagram for Part 1 (why neuroscience needs mathematics). Use via ImageMobject(ASSET_PATHS['fig_measurement_funnel']).

fig_mindmap_three_pillars.description: Composite PNG (matplotlib layout + Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- the mind map with only the three foundational pillars (Linear Algebra, Calculus & Dynamical Systems, Statistics & Probability) lit, the two applied nodes still muted. Use for Part 3's transition and any pillar-recap beat via ImageMobject(ASSET_PATHS['fig_mindmap_three_pillars']).

fig_mindmap_full.description: Composite PNG (matplotlib layout + Bootstrap Icons, MIT licensed) -- the complete 5-node mind map, all nodes lit. Use for Part 7's expansion and the closing full reveal via ImageMobject(ASSET_PATHS['fig_mindmap_full']).
